fullName: truck-junction-web-automation:cypress/e2e/ui/Buses/BusListing.cy.js#Buses - BusListing [popularBuses] [en] — Popular Buses TC-BUS-01: lead submits successfully on Popular Buses
description:
**Test Case ID:** TC-BUS-01
**Title:** Lead submits successfully on Popular Buses
**Language:** en

**Description:**
Open the Popular Buses page, click "Check Bus Price" to open its lead form, fill name, mobile and city, and submit.

**Expected Result:**
A Thank You confirmation is shown after a successful lead submission.

**Steps:**
1. Open the Popular Buses page
2. Click "Check Bus Price" to open its lead form
3. Fill name, mobile and city
4. Submit and verify Thank You confirmation
